releases.notes:
# CuisineCraft 0.0.7

## Added

### Cutting Board
- New **Cutting Board** block with a 3D model
- Place an ingredient on the board, then cut it with a **Knife**; each cut uses 1 durability
- Each ingredient needs a set number of cuts, with sounds and particles on every cut
- The ingredient is shown lying on the board; take it back with an empty hand
- Cutting recipes: Potato → Fries, Raw Beef → Raw Patty, Bread → Breadcrumbs, Tomato → Chopped Tomato, Raw Salmon → Raw Salmon Fillet, Raw Cod → Raw Cod Fillet, Wasabi Root → Wasabi Paste
- Recipe: 3 wooden slabs in the bottom row and a stick in the top-right corner

### Sushi
- New crops: **Wasabi** and **Soybeans** (found by breaking grass)
- New ingredients: **Nori, Cooked Rice, Rice Vinegar, Sushi Rice, Soy Sauce, Wasabi Paste, Raw Salmon Fillet, Raw Cod Fillet, Chopped Tomato**
- New tool: **Bamboo Sushi Mat** (64 uses, stays in the crafting grid)
- New dishes: **Kappa Maki, California Roll, Shrimp Tempura Roll, Salmon Nigiri, Cod Nigiri, Sushi Set**
- Sushi pieces are eaten quickly
- The **Sushi Set** grants Water Breathing for 60 seconds

## Changed
- **Fries, Raw Patty and Breadcrumbs** are now made on the Cutting Board instead of the crafting grid
- **Tomato Soup** now uses 3 Chopped Tomatoes and no longer requires a Knife
- Grass now also drops Wasabi Roots and Soybeans

## Fixed
- Removed the "Worlds using Experimental Settings" warning when creating or loading a world (Minecraft 1.21.1 and Fabric 1.20.1)

## Notes
- Minecraft 1.12.2 has no kelp, bamboo, smoker or campfire: Nori is smelted from a Lily Pad, the Sushi Mat uses Sugar Cane, and Rice is cooked in a Furnace only
- Available for Forge 1.12.2, 1.16.5, 1.18.2, 1.19.2, 1.20.1, 1.21.1, Fabric 1.20.1, 1.21.1 and NeoForge 1.21.1

releases.notes:
# CuisineCraft 0.0.6

## Added

- Added Breadcrumbs, crafted from Bread
- Added Breaded Shrimp, made with Raw Shrimp, Breadcrumbs, and Salt
- Added Crispy Shrimp, prepared in the Fryer
- Added the Shrimp Burger
- Added Shrimp Fried Rice
- Added new recipes, item models, textures, and translations for all new foods

## Improved

- Shrimp now spawn naturally only in ocean biomes
- Improved Shrimp spawning behavior near the ocean floor
- Improved gameplay consistency between all supported mod versions
- Updated food textures and fixed unwanted transparent pixels
- Updated version and loader compatibility information

## Fixed

- Fixed the Shrimp model moving backwards due to incorrect model orientation
- Fixed inconsistencies in recipes, drops, crop yields, and food values between different Minecraft versions
- Fixed Shrimp Fried Rice not returning a Bowl after being eaten
- Fixed several overly broad Minecraft and mod-loader compatibility ranges
- Fixed misleading version information in release filenames

releases.notes:
- New entity: Shrimp — a small ocean creature with custom 3D model and texture
- Shrimp naturally spawn in ocean biomes in large groups (8–20 per group)
- Realistic behavior: shrimp stay on the seafloor, occasionally dart forward, die on land
- New item: Raw Shrimp — dropped when a shrimp is killed (1 per kill, no looting bonus)
- New item: Cooked Shrimp — craftable by smelting Raw Shrimp in a furnace (nutrition: 3, saturation: 0.8)
- New item: Shrimp Spawn Egg — allows manual spawning of shrimp
Killing a shrimp grants 1–3 XP
